Itaque vos estis] Repetit quod dixit, eóque in-

Certò enim potest, quisquis fideliter defunctus

tribuendam.
CAPUT III.
ARGUMENTUM.
Hoc capite primùm perfistit in excusatione sui, ad al-

flictiones patienter perferendas, ad verf. usque5. Ubi ad

The Greek word in the second paragraph (πεποίθησιν) is uncertain and marked [?]. Long s was rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. Christi, est, sui), as instructed. The bottom of the page ends with the paragraph "2 Misi-" cut off by the page edge, so its continuation is not visible.
